_comment: Most recent working model per family per provider. Auto-updated periodically by `python scripts/probe_models.py --check-new` which queries each provider's /v1/models endpoint (free, no quota cost). Adding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY to env makes claude/gemini auto-discoverable too. Order is initial test order ONLY — quality ranking comes from logs/cost_log.jsonl via _routeModel.
